steps.title: Coat 6‑well plate
steps.instruction: Coat each well with gelatin 0.1% or Geltrex LDEV‑Free hESC Quality (5 mL, 1:100 dilution) using Thermo Fisher Catalog #A1413302.

steps.title: Collect organoid spheres
steps.instruction: Collect 10–20 brain‑organoid spheres (day 40 +) and place them into the coated 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Wash spheres
steps.instruction: Wash the spheres twice with PBS.

steps.title: Add TrypLE enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL TrypLE™ Select Enzyme (1×, no phenol red, Thermo Fisher Catalog #12563011) to each well and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Triturate tissue
steps.instruction: Triturate the suspension using a glass pipette, performing 2–3 up‑and‑down motions.

steps.title: Transfer cells to plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the cells and any tissue chunks to the coated 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Add astrocyte medium
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL astrocyte medium (per well) as described at https://www.sciencellonline.com/astrocyte-medium.html.

steps.title: Half‑media change (orange)
steps.instruction: Perform a half‑volume media change every 3 days, continuing until the medium turns orange.

steps.title: Half‑media change (attachment)
steps.instruction: Continue half‑volume media changes every 3 days until a satisfactory amount of cells have attached to the plate (may vary with patterning).

steps.title: Passage astrocytes
steps.instruction: When cultures reach ~80 % confluency, passage the astrocytes onto a gelatin‑ or Geltrex‑coated 15 cm plate using astrocyte medium.

steps.title: Incubate in maturation media
steps.instruction: For downstream experiments, incubate the passaged cells in maturation media (details to be determined).
